findings.text: The manifest's checkpoint describes quiet-count-head-rerun.log and cohort-spotcheck.log as re-measured/re-run "at this head", but each log's own `# revision:` header names 25f5db63 (the prior head, before the refactor commit 3280f08c): quiet-count-head-rerun.log:3 and cohort-spotcheck.log:2 both read 25f5db63. The post-refactor evidence is the gate pair gate-env-unset.log / gate-env-set.log (8 passed each, header revision 3280f08c) and negative-control-declared.log (header revision 3280f08c), so the increment's own measure is covered; the two stale-header logs do not falsify the gate but the manifest states a revision they do not.

notes: Reuse read allowed outside the diff: reckon/git_dates.py:230 _head_identity is the owner, and reckon/change_streams.py:15 and reckon/serve.py:113 already import _file_identity / _git_directory / _head_identity, so reaching the private reader is the repo's established idiom. Verified head_stamp has no remaining referent (git grep head_stamp at 3280f08c is empty). Verified the reused _head_identity covers the packed-refs case the old head_stamp watched: a commit writes the loose ref, pack-refs removes it and the ref's presence is part of the identity, so both move the reading, and a packed-ref moving without a commit changes no commit id. Verified the test autouse fixture clears RECKON_FOLLOWER_SOURCE_ROOT so the source fixture is hermetic (the prior review's second finding).
review_run_id_note: this review covers only the one commit gained since the prior review r-20261019T204700073796 (which read base 3b652d4b, head 25f5db63)

verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 25f5db63; one commit (3280f08c) adds the git_dates import and the _head_identity call and deletes _git_directory / _git_common_directory / _file_fingerprint / head_stamp, plus a test autouse fixture and one assertion swap, all inside the declared scope.
verdicts.done_when: the goal's done_when names four behaviours, a stamp-through-gitdir check, a non-memoised failure and a 30 s allocation count; the increment re-ran the eight-check gate at the true head (gate-env-unset.log / gate-env-set.log, 8 passed each, header revision 3280f08c) and the declared negative control (negative-control-declared.log, 6 failed / 2 passed).
verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to memoise source_code_identity per root against a stamp of HEAD and the ref it names; the gained commit reckon/checkout_trust.py:433 reads git_dates._head_identity for that stamp and deletes the four local helpers.
verdicts.manifest: read; it records the refactor, the two-env gate (8 passed each), the head negative control and the paired cohort arms, and its tests line names the literal gate command.
verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; the gained commit touches only reckon/checkout_trust.py, tests/test_the_code_identity_is_read_only_when_head_moves.py and the evidence fragment, all inside them.
